analogue: Particle-phase addition of a pinene-derived alcohol to a cyclic acylperoxyhemiacetal to form dimer esters in α-pinene SOA.
citation: Particle-phase accretion forms dimer esters in pinene secondary organic aerosol
evidence: Authentic standards established structures of major ester dimers, and experiments located their formation in particles from pinene ozonolysis.
difference: The two reactants have distinct structures despite being represented by one P_A pool. The bulk rate, irreversible retention and fraction of Manchester organic mass converted remain unmeasured.
